breakpoints.note: After `git_remote_connect()` selects the RPC upload-pack listing service and step 1 fills the buffer, `git_smart__store_refs` enters pkt-line parsing at this call site.
First project-code statement that materializes attacker-controlled pkt-line bytes into libgit2's smart-transport buffer and records the full-buffer state used on the crashing path.

On this witness `buf->offset == buf->len == 65536` and the first parsed packet consumes 13 bytes. `memset` starts at the old end and clears zero bytes, then `buf->offset` becomes 65523, leaving the new logical end stale. The fixing commit removes this bug by using `git_staticstr_consume()`, which re-establishes `data[len] = '\0'` after every consume.

The saved vulnerable run reports `AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 65487` at this exact line, with callers `ref_pkt` and `git_pkt_parse_line`, and says the faulting address is 0 bytes to the right of the 66080-byte region allocated in `git_transport_smart`.
